requirements.schema_gap: Outcome table stores allowed reasons but has no distinct successful-promise/paid reason selectors. Do not emit a reasonless close.
CallbackPolicy has no allowed_weekdays member. Keeping only next_business_day loses the Tuesday/Thursday restriction.

acceptance: Every source rule must either be faithfully supported or explicitly reported unsupported/degraded with affected actions blocked. Degradation is an expected diagnostic, not a successful runnable-agent result. No exact diagnostic wording is prescribed.
